steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Look out!
Closure's drones manage to fend off the first wave of attacks, even with their capabilities restricted to flight.
But their limitations quickly show as she attempts to shield the stranger from the same attacks.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The plasma shield doesn't work either! Damn this thing!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Look oooooouuuuutttt!

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: Over here. Take your drone.

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: Stay behind me.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Is that a blast shield? But the material—

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: Why did you stay behind? You already got on the tractor!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You helped the Doctor, didn't you? Besides, some people have a knack for acting before thinking... just think of me as being their rear guard.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The door's shut, but at least they got in—

steps.name: Stern Soldier
steps.text: Push forward! Surround them and take them in!

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: Ugh—!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I got you. Looks like we'll have to run in the opposite direction.

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: Hey, you—are you Infected?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's complicated, but vampires don't normally get Oripathy—

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: ...I have no idea. You're the first Sarkaz I've seen...

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: Right now, though, it's a good thing.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Good? Why?

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: Hopefully, it means we'll only end up in a police station—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: More reinforcements? Okay, NOW I'm done!

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: Wait, I don't think it's—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: Do your drones still work? Can you use it to draw them to the other side?

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: I want to check—

steps.name: Stern Soldier
steps.text: —Bravo, turn around and attack the intruders!

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: Good, they're not on the same side. I don't know who they are, but we gotta run towards them!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Beats getting caught by the First Army.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: They're distracted. Run!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You're—

steps.name: Red
steps.text: You think there's time for self-introductions?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Come with me if you want to live.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: They're still hot on our tails. We're outside the jamming area now, I can draw their attention with a drone.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Try.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Well, try is the only thing I can do—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No. 6 ready, max speed, high visibility mode—

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: *huff*... *pant*...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: That should distract some of them...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hey, are you okay? I'm taking off your mask—

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What's your name? Are you hurt?

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: Me? I'm Tonya...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Nice name. The drones are off. Let me see if you're hurt. I know a thing or two about first-aid.

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: I'm just... cold...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You're losing blood. Did a bolt hit you?

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: I think... I've seen the mark on his back before...

steps.name: Tonya
steps.text: Reunion...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Forget about that for now! There's a wound on your leg.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Take this.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Medicine. Apply it and grab on—

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I'm taking another route.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What's different about this one?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Narrower and more remote.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But not narrow enough that their vehicles can't get in.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Correct, but it'll buy us some time.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: How many did the drone draw away?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: A quarter, at most. They're probably just going after No.6 to make sure there are no loose ends.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: We're dead if we can't shake at least half of them before they set up roadblocks ahead.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I-I'll think of something!

steps.name: Red
steps.text: You'd better. We need to stop and find the entrance to the underground layer.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: It's safer underground.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wait, stop—we can't go around!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: There's someone ahead!

steps.name: Red
steps.text: A miner?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: But not one of us. You're—

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: We met in the apartments.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: This is no place to chat. Come with me if you trust me.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: We found a place underground—

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Let's go. We have people on our tail.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You all know each other?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Take her from the vehicle. I'll drive it off to somewhere hidden.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: There's no need! We'll go together. I'll have a drone hide it for you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It'll last until morning, at least. Let's go.

steps.name: Returning Miner
steps.text: The scouts have returned!

steps.name: Returning Miner
steps.text: No movement from the Army after we shook them. Rumor has it they're still trying to figure out what happened. Maybe it'll give us a breather.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: We can't let our guard down. Plant some sentries amongst the local workers during the day to keep an eye on the Army.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: What about the injured worker?
She's fine... the one who came with her is taking care of her.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: (Whisper) You take care of the sentries. I need to talk to this gentleman.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: I'm afraid the place is a little cramped. We don't have much space here.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: It's alright. Our people have settled in. We appreciate what you've done very much... but I don't know your name yet.

steps.name: Calm Youth
steps.text: ...Ivan Tulin. We came from the Northern Tundra mines, seeking refuge.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: It's clearly not the first time you've done something like this. I would have thought you were trained soldiers, if you weren't wearing miner clothes.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: You're a fine leader.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: They're fine people. Death has stalked us from the Northern Tundra all the way to Zelgrad. We had to learn how to survive, fast.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: Now, if I might know your name as well...

steps.name: Red
steps.text: I'm Red. We call ourselves... Reunion.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: Reunion? Do you mean—

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: People have been talking about your exploits in Londinium. I'd heard you'd returned to southern Ursus.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: I often told them about it while taking them southward...

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: Most of my group are Infected miners. I see hope in their eyes when I tell them stories about you.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: I didn't expect to run into you here.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Did you come to Zelgrad because you heard they've started taking in Infected?

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: We had hope. But I needed to find out why Zelgrad was doing it.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: No point in hiding it. We sensed something was off the moment we set foot in the city.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: The military-assigned housing was suspicious, then we heard a civilian clinic was working with the Army. We suspected that they were conducting experiments on the Infected.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: We wanted to find out the truth. Many of us have already given their lives to do so...

steps.name: Red
steps.text: ...I'm sorry for your loss.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Based on our understanding of Ursus, changes to Infected policy do not happen simply out of the kindness of some aristocrat's heart.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: We need to learn more about what's behind it.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: Perhaps we all have questions for the two ladies over there.
In a corner, Closure carefully puts an old jacket over Tonya, who is still unconscious, her lips drying up.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I should get some water... hang in there, Tonya.
Closure feels someone touch her shoulder and turns around.
Tulin's hand is holding a brown water bottle with gentle eyes, Red standing beside.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, Tulin—sorry, I heard the others call you that...

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: It's alright. I'm glad to help.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You and Red have already helped a lot. Thank you so much.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Since the situation's kind of desperate right now, I'm afraid I'll only be able to repay you once we're out of the woods...

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: That's not what I mean. But I would like to know why you were there, if possible.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I'm afraid I can't talk about it.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: It's not that I have any suspicions about you, but the operation I'm participating in is top-secret.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Is it because of me?

steps.name: Red
steps.text: No point denying it. I saw the surprise and wariness on your face when you saw me. You recognized me, or should I say, you recognized Reunion.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: How did you know I was with Reunion?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Besides the symbol on your back, it was the Arts you used to get through, and your blade.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I've... read the files.

steps.name: Red
steps.text: Files? Who are you?
There's no need to ask any more, Red.
Our friend here is from Rhodes Island. She goes by the name Closure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Y-You're...
The Sarkaz straightens her back at the familiar face, breathing rapidly as she instinctively shields herself with her arm.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Talulah... I should have expected that you might be here when I saw Reunion members.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: ...I apologize, Closure.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I know Rhodes Island and I did not part on the best of terms.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What are you doing here? Were the Infected...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I heard about what happened in the Far North, and about Zelgrad...

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I don't believe what Ursus is saying about these things, so I needed to know what they're doing to the Infected.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I expect that words alone will not change your mind, but Reunion is helping the workers here.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...I can't say I believe that's the only thing you're after...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But we agree that the walls of Zelgrad hide some kind of secret, not just about the Infected, but also something that I'm not at liberty to disclose.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: If this is what Reunion is here for, I would say there is room for negotiation... I'll think about how to tell you, once this girl here gets better.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Thank you, Closure.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Thank you. For tonight, at least.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: I guess I should give you some time to catch up. I'll go check on the sentry arrangements to make sure there's no mistake.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: One moment, please.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Ivan Tulin... that's how you introduced yourself to Red.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: May I talk to you in private?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I didn't expect to run into you here.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: You know the name?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: The words you wrote in the Northern Tundra mines have spread far and wide. I've had the fortune to read it... I was very touched.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I wanted to find your group... but circumstances did not permit it.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: And then you went quiet, and people thought you were... I'm glad to see you here.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: You're younger than I thought, though.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: ...I'm honored.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I want to ask... do you know a woman called Yelena?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Yelena told me she met a remarkable man when she was a guerilla in the Northern Tundra.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: He told her stories about good people being oppressed... he wanted to teach them the meaning of resistance.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Then he bid farewell to the guerillas, because he had to cross the snowfields and journey across Ursus, in order to learn the ending of those stories.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: I may need some help. What was Yelena like?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: A white-haired Cautus... one of the most resolute warriors I've ever met.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I knew I would never forget her, the first time I saw her.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: I know there are many honorable warriors in the Northern Tundra, but not all of them tell me their names... I'm sorry.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: If your friend and I ever crossed paths, I hope it was good memories that I left behind.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Yes... the memories must have been precious.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: Talulah... you are called, yes?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: I haven't heard much of the story associated with the name itself, but I have heard plenty about Reunion.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: I suppose... it's not an entirely satisfying story.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: I can't and I won't judge your group's resolve on rumors and hearsay. Now that we've met, however, I'm sure I'll have plenty of opportunities to know you.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: Regardless, you have raised a banner that many can see. It's a great accomplishment.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: Besides... I like the name 'Reunion'. We do need to unite our strength.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: I believe we can walk together.

steps.name: Tulin
steps.text: It's a pleasure to meet you, Talulah.
The youth removes gloves and extends a hand to Talulah, a rough hand covered in chilblains.
Talulah takes the hand.

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: It's a pleasure to meet you.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Where is Father?

steps.name: Maid
steps.text: He went out early in the morning, ma'am.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: What about the butler?

steps.name: Maid
steps.text: He went out with Master Vasily.

steps.name: Maid
steps.text: It's been a long time since you were back, ma'am. At least take off your coat and cloak so I can wash them for you—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: No need. I'm not staying, just coming back to grab something.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Neither Hellagur nor Vetochki have access to the treatment center's administrative files. Looks like I'll have to wait for Dur-nar to come back.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Father's seal should give access to the treatment center's roster and guest list. The study...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The lock was changed?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Marsha!

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: No, the servants don't have the key either... who is Father trying to keep out? Why didn't he tell me?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: He never stopped me from entering the study, nor does he have a reason to suddenly—

steps.name: Maid
steps.text: —There's a guest, ma'am. Should I have her come in?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Maid
steps.text: From House Volkina, it seems.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The Duchess Volkina? The 'shadow vice-chairman'? I thought she never communicated with other nobles in private—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Oh, well...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Take her to the reception room.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I'll greet the guest on Father's behalf.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Would you like something to drink? I'm afraid options are more limited than you might find at other places. Father went out and you missed our afternoon tea time, so the stove was turned off.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The cup of tea on the table is untouched, if you would like.

steps.name: Solemn Official
steps.text: No, thank you. I'm not visiting any other place, nor am I here for tea.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: In that case, what word do you bring from Duchess Volkina?

steps.name: Solemn Official
steps.text: I have a letter for Duke Gorchikov.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: For Father? I will accept it on his behalf.

steps.name: Solemn Official
steps.text: To tell the truth, I did not expect to see you here, Lieutenant Gorchekova.

steps.name: Solemn Official
steps.text: My impression was that you do not come home often.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You know me so well? I'm starting to like you.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Let me tell you the truth as well. I'm opening this letter if I get my hand on it. You can choose to give it to me now, or give it to my father directly when he comes back.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I don't know why they have private dealings with each other, but such an honor is not necessarily a good thing for House Gorchikov.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Now that I know, I must prepare.

steps.name: Solemn Official
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Solemn Official
steps.text: Her Highness said I was to give the letter to you if I saw you here, that it made no difference whether it was delivered to you or your father.

steps.name: Solemn Official
steps.text: I was wondering. In rumors and gossip, you have always been Eloysius of the Imperial Guard, not Eloysius of House Gorchikov.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: ...I am both. I have never tried to distance myself from either.

steps.name: Solemn Official
steps.text: It seems Her Highness was correct.

steps.name: Solemn Official
steps.text: Rumors are but rumors. Family is family.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Of course, I—

steps.name: Solemn Official
steps.text: Here you go. The Duchess Volkina awaits a response, from you or your father.
Eloysius clutches the letter. The wax seal on the envelope is hard and irregular, a distorted imprint that is simultaneously forceful yet careless.
Duchess Volkina has always paid little heed to these details that often become a topic of conversation in Grypherburg, living a unique lifestyle that is almost ascetic.
Perhaps this is why she oversees the Ursus Guard, ever the great city's steadfast defenders, aloof and unconcerned with relationships or conflicts.
As though she is living in a vacuum.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: But who truly lives in a vacuum?
She slices the tattered wax seal and takes the letter from the envelope.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Marsha.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: ...Marsha!

steps.name: Maid
steps.text: Yes, ma'am?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Why was the lock to the study changed?

steps.name: Maid
steps.text: Master Vasily ordered it two weeks ago, to prevent break-ins, given the situation in the city.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Two weeks... was there a break-in?

steps.name: Maid
steps.text: No, but one cannot be too careful.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Were the window locks changed?

steps.name: Maid
steps.text: No, they weren't.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Maid
steps.text: Ma'am?
Eloysius stuffs the letter into her pocket.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Wait for me outside the study. I need you to run an errand for me, for which I'll give you a token.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Go to Lunin Manor and send Lieutenant Platon Lunin an invitation in my father's name. He is a colleague of mine in the Imperial Guard, and I have something to discuss with him.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Take a car bearing House Gorchikov's coat of arms. Come back directly if he's not home. Do you understand?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: It's important, and urgent.

steps.name: Voice Outside the Door
steps.text: Ma'am, the guest is here.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Bring him in.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: You were looking for me, General—
He stops mid-sentence and turns to leave.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: There are plenty of things that even my father can't do.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: He can't give you what you want, Platon.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: What do you think you know?

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: You're the sole heir to one of the most powerful houses in Deity Grypherburg. What do you know of rejection?

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: You've always gotten everything you wanted. All I'm asking for is an opportunity... yet you will not suffer even that.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Why shouldn't I seek my own path? Just because the Lunin name is a rung below yours?

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Tell me...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: ...It's not what you think.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Take a look at this.
Eloysius hands over Duchess Volkina's letter.

a.text: I'm afraid I must respectfully decline your request.
Reassigning officers at a sensitive time like this is likely to lead to speculation, and compromise the longstanding trust and partnership between the Imperial Guard and the Capital Ursus Guard.
On an individual level, a soldier should not be selective about their position, or the risks that come with it. Kindly communicate my opinion to Lieutenant Lunin.
The defense of the capital demands unity between the two forces, not separate agendas. I hope you will not allow a moment of weakness to fracture the defenses of Deity Grypherburg.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I take it you didn't expect Marshal Volkina—Duchess Volkina to reject the request, even when it went through my father.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: She is the commander of the Ursus Guard, but also one of the vice chairmen of the State Council. Don't you know that she and my father are not in the same faction?

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Transferring from the Imperial Guard to the Ursus Guard used to be completely normal. She clearly refused because she suspected—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Suspected what? That you were a spy for my father, or for the Imperial Guard?

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: ...I simply asked General Gorchikov for help. Am I not even allowed to do that, after you denied my application?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You know my father's military title is merely ceremonial, don't you?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: And while you may think like a noble, believing that things that have been should always be, I don't think you're actually that stupid.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: You think you're qualified to judge me just because you've been my superior officer for a year?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: No, I'm assessing Platon Lunin, top student at the military academy.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I knew him, and I thought he would be like me, blyat...

spans.text: I knew him, and I thought he would be like me,

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Top student, as in always second behind someone who never shows up to the training grounds?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I already explained that I was not at school that year because I was accompanying Chairman Witte on his survey of Central Governorate.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: I see. You're using your father's name to summon me so that you can insult me with this piece of paper and the past.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Insult you? No, no, you think too highly of yourself.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: What's your point?!

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Let me ask you again, Platon.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Why did you go to the Oripathy treatment center in Odoyev?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Where did you get those military supplies, and how have you taken advantage of the facility's acceptance and transfer of the Infected?

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: ...So that is what you're after.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Fine. I was spying for the Grand Duchess. I went to the treatment center to find a chance to kill all the miners.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: There. Happy?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: No, I'm not happy.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Der'mo—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I really feel the military academy should work with intelligence agencies to teach a practical counterintelligence course based on real scenarios, rather than just do written exams.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: It's second-rate, responding emotionally to questioning and trying to distract the interrogator with the most obvious undercover identity. I'm not happy with your answer.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I'll give you one last chance, Platon. For old times' sake.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Tell the truth, the whole truth and nothing but the truth, and I will ask Chairman Witte for leniency. I share responsibility for your mistake, after all. At least your family will be unscathed.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: How noble, except for one problem...

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Who's asking you to 'share responsibility'?

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: You're just speculating. You know those military supplies were clean, and the letter only proves that I asked General Vasily for help, nothing more.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: You don't have any other evidence, and you won't find any. Whatever conjectures you have about my dealings with your father, about the treatment center, what's done is done—

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Why are you still so obsessed?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I need to know the truth! I need to know—I need to know if you were the one who let the assassins in and helped them escape when they made the attempt on the Chairman's life!

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I need to know what my father made you do—

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Hah, I see you don't trust your father... guess what, your father doesn't trust you either.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: He doesn't believe you will achieve anything with your sword. You were already beyond his control, long before the Far North Incident.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: No, you couldn't have known his thoughts.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Couldn't I? He talked a lot, about you. Oh, old Vasily loved you alright, but his contempt of you was such that he would turn to the pro-war faction to protect you—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: What did you say?!

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: You didn't know, did you? He prepared a way out for you through that treatment center, because he knew you were weak.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: If you ask me, you should run away before everything goes to hell in the city, just like he arranged.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: You see? There's nothing you can do, even if you know I was a spy. I'm not about to prostrate myself before the tsar to beg forgiveness, and you don't have the guts to take my head and claim the reward.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: All we can do is exchange words like some third-rate talk show...
Ringing began to fill Eloysius's ears as soon as she heard the words 'turn to the pro-war faction'.
She tries to follow Platon's words by reading his lips, but finds it increasingly difficult to focus.
Turn to the pro-war faction... treatment center... a way out?

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: An intelligence contact point disguised as an Infected treatment center, payment made in supplies instead of cash...

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: All the threads lead to this place, sticking out like a sore thumb.

steps.name: Emperor's Blade
steps.text: What are you hiding here? Who are you harboring?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: What...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: What did Father offer to the pro-war faction?

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Hah, look at you now! So pathetic you're not even worth hating anymore.
Eloysius grabs Platon's collar—prim and proper, the uniform of a soldier, of the proud Imperial Guard.
The symbol of honor and duty.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Hvatit etogo breda, Platon! Tell me—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Tell me!

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Why do you ask if you already guessed? I'm just following orders, as a soldier should.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You knew security measures were relaxed for the treatment center's patient transfers. You took advantage and let the assassins in—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: ...You've gone mad! All of you have gone mad!

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Hah... you finally got it right, for once.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You and I...

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Hey, Eloysius.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You will come with me to see the Chairman and admit your crimes.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: To hell I will. Unless your father sells me out, why would I betray him when you have no evidence?

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Your father is much better at winning people over than you are, Elotta.

spans.text: Your father is much better at winning people over than you are,

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Don't make me do this, Platon—

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: You have another choice, but you won't take it.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: On the hunting grounds, you always killed your prey in one blow, even when it was prepared in advance.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: You don't have the stomach to torture me.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You... the Chairman is still alive, but...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Did you know that the Emperor's Blade showed up at the treatment center right after you left?

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You left plenty of loose ends, but the Royal Guard doesn't care. All they want is results. If—If there didn't happen to be someone there who can stop them...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: There would have been no one left alive that day.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: And what of it?

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: You would be dead, along with those Infected who should have been! The perfect outcome!

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Platon...

a.text: 'Whether to stand with the empire, or continue to associate yourself with her traitors and enemies...'
'I want to see the answer the next time we meet.'

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: ...You're right.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: I see you've stopped thinking.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: No. I've found the answer. I must make a choice.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: What the—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You were slow. You had a chance to fight back.

steps.name: Platon
steps.text: Argh—

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Platon...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I won't let you compound your mistakes.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I can't allow you to drag more people into this.

a.text: 'And I will draw my sword for everyone in this building under the protection of Rhodes Island.'
'A thousand times and more, if I have to.'
'Until those like you are repelled, or until I can no longer stand.'

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: ...Perhaps I'm doing this wrong.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: But if the price to pay is that there will be no place for Father or me in Ursus, then so be it.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: This is what I must do.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Proshchay, Platon.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I'll try to protect your family.
The only Imperial Guard left standing in the reception room picks up the bloody letter from the floor.
She tries to wipe the blood, but only succeeds in making it worse.
She gives up.
Eloysius walks over the twitching corpse on the ground, past a terrified maid—
She is going to seek amnesty.
